subject: Re: Saturday cleanup
text:
Hi Mara,

You were right to write. The park cleanup should have gone smoother. I am sorry. You arrived early. You brought bags. You expected gloves. We did not have enough. That was my mistake. I checked the supply list. I missed the order. I feel bad.

I want to fix this. Please come to the next event. It is Saturday. It is at the north entrance. I will bring fresh supplies. I will bring gloves. I will bring snacks. I will also bring water. We can use your help again. You know the neighborhood well. You know the paths.

If cleanup feels too hard now, there is another idea. You could join the morning walk. We are counting litter locations. We are not picking it up. We are just making a map. It takes less effort. It is still useful. The team can clean those spots later.

Your report mattered. I shared it with the group. We changed the packing method. We now double-check kits. The new checklist is ready. It is simple. It shows what we learned.

No blame is needed here. We will do better. I will save a place for you. The map project starts at nine. Bring a friend if you like.

I value you. I value your time. I do not want you discouraged. Please reply. Tell me what works for you. I can meet for coffee too. We can talk about what should change.

Thanks.
Sam
